Blaster Master Jr..name: Blaster Master Boy
Blaster Master Jr..summary: Blaster Master Jr., known as Blaster Master Boy in North America and Bomber King: Scenario 2 (ボンバーキング シナリオ2?) in Japan, is an action video game developed by Aicom and published by Sunsoft. The game was released in 1991 for Game Boy. The game is a sequel to Robowarrior, a spin-off title in the Bomberman series by Hudson Soft. However, the game was marketed in western territories as a game in the Blaster Master series by Sunsoft.

Hello Kitty - Pocket Camera.name: Hello Kitty Pocket Camera
Hello Kitty - Pocket Camera.summary: Hello Kitty Pocket Camera was a cancelled version of Nintendo's Game Boy Camera. It was only discovered after a data breach in September 2020 which leaked the game online.

Kudzu.name: Kudzu
Kudzu.summary: Zoen, a master gardener and your mentor, has wandered into the fast-growing kudzu field and mysteriously disappeared. It is up to you and your arsenal of gardening tools - such as a rake, hoe, and machete - to hack your way through the overgrowth and bring Zoen back.
